queries.name: Find All Recoverable Tombstones (Deleted State)

queryList.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n.group_membership_recoverable = true AND (n:GhostHound_TombstoneUser OR n:GhostHound_TombstoneComputer OR n:GhostHound_TombstoneGroup) RETURN n

queries.description: Finds all AD tombstones that are in the full-fidelity 'Deleted' state (Recycle Bin) and can be recovered with their previous group memberships.

queries.name: Shortest Path to Domain Admins via Reanimation

queryList.query: MATCH (n:GhostHound_TombstoneUser), (g:Group), p=shortestPath((n)-[*1..]->(g)) WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' RETURN p

queries.description: Finds attack paths from a TombstoneUser to Domain Admins, leveraging the GhostHound_CanReanimate/GhostHound_WasMemberOf edges plus the GhostHound_SameAs bridge into the real Group node. Requires bridge_shadow_nodes.cypher to have been run against Neo4j after import (see docs/adr/0006) -- without it, GhostHound_WasMemberOf's target is an unbridged placeholder and this query returns nothing.
